reason: A shell-overlay whale widget that visualizes agent activity and DeepSeek API balance through an interactive desktop-style interface.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 界面中提供交互式鲸鱼挂件，用海水水位展示 API 余额并实时反映智能体状态。
summaries.en: An interactive whale widget for DeepSeek Harness that visualizes API balance as a sea level and reflects live agent status.

capabilities: Displays live agent status in a shell-overlay widget
Reads DeepSeek API balance through the harness credential mechanism
Polls the DeepSeek balance endpoint periodically
Provides interactive drag, minimize, click, and animation behavior
